brief:
Five UN special rapporteurs have raised alarm over escalating legal proceedings against Rima Hassan, a Palestinian-French member of the European Parliament, Shehab Wire reported. The experts expressed "profound concern" about the measures being taken against her, characterizing the actions as both political and judicial in nature. Hassan represents Palestinian causes in the European legislature and has drawn scrutiny for her advocacy and public statements on the issue.

The UN officials view the mounting charges against her as part of a broader pattern of persecution linked directly to her political work and speech. The rapporteurs' warning underscores tensions between free expression rights and legal accountability in cases involving high-profile advocates on contentious regional matters.
